INSERT INTO tv_watch_states (id, episode_id, user_id, watched, watched_at, position_seconds)
        SELECT gen_random_uuid(), e.id, $1, TRUE, $2, NULL
        FROM tv_episodes e
        WHERE e.id = ANY($3)
        ON CONFLICT (episode_id, user_id)
        DO UPDATE SET
            watched = TRUE,
            watched_at = $2,
            position_seconds = NULL,
            updated_at = NOW()
        RETURNING episode_id
